e.title_en: I worked three policies out on paper and committed the results as golden fixtures: an integer-cents, no-float-anywhere rule that makes every quote reproducible by hand to the cent, intermediates included
e.title_hk: 「我把三份保單**用紙筆算了一遍，並把結果作為黃金夾具提交進倉庫**」：一條「金額全程整數分、不含任何浮點」的規則，使每一份報價都能被手算復現到分（連中間值一起）
e.summary: 一份个人车险的**费率引擎 ＋ 理赔结算计算器 ＋ 再定价工具**（回答「改一个费率因子，整本保单会怎样」），自称出发点是想在**算术层面**搞清车险定价与赔付到底怎么运作，因此全部从零写起；**其最值得记的一处是一条自设的算术规则**——**逐字为「我全程给自己定的规则：**金额是整数分，因子是以 1000 为标度缩放的整数，只在有记录的节点上做四舍五入（half up）**。**金额路径上没有一个浮点数**，这正是使每一份报价与每一次结算**可以被精确复现并被手算核对**的原因。」**——**⭐ 即它把「可手算核对」当成一个**算术设计的后果**，而不是一句承诺**；**并且它真的手算了**：**「`Quote` 对象暴露每一个中间步骤，于是你可以拿着费率表和一张纸复现任何一份保费。**我对三份完整保单正是这么做的，并把它们作为黄金夹具提交在 `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`；测试断言引擎与我的手算在**分**的层面上一致，**包括中间值**。」**；**另有三处同一纪律**：**① 同一输入两次定价必得同一保费**——**逐字「这听起来是显然的，但**它是一条被测过的性质，不是一个假设**」**；**② 三个赔付不变量（赔付不为负、不超过限额、免赔额恰好扣一次）用**两种方式**验证**——**手算的边界矩阵（覆盖在每一个免赔额、限额与上限的**下方、等于、以及高出一分**三处）＋随机扫查（**每类结算 10 万个带种子的随机案例、合计 30 万，零不变量违反**）**；**③ 它有一节专门的**「本模型不做什么」**，含「费率表是编的、不是任何保险人报备的费率、这里不为真实保险定价」「真实核保还用驾驶人记录点数、车辆符号、允许时的信用分、车联网，且建立在拟合模型上而非五因子链」「按比例分摊只是**一种**合理惯例，真实承保人可能顺序结算或协商结算」「基准是 Apple 芯片上的单线程纯 Python，且结算路径比定价路径轻得多，这就是吞吐量差 30 倍的原因」
e.summary_hk: 一份個人車險的**費率引擎 ＋ 理賠結算計算器 ＋ 再定價工具**（回答「改一個費率因子，整本保單會怎樣」），自稱出發點是想在**算術層面**搞清車險定價與賠付到底怎麼運作，因此全部從零寫起；**其最值得記的一處是一條自設的算術規則**——**逐字為「我全程給自己定的規則：**金額是整數分，因子是以 1000 為標度縮放的整數，只在有記錄的節點上做四捨五入（half up）**。**金額路徑上沒有一個浮點數**，這正是使每一份報價與每一次結算**可以被精確復現並被手算核對**的原因。」**——**⭐ 即它把「可手算核對」當成一個**算術設計的後果**，而不是一句承諾**；**並且它真的手算了**：**「`Quote` 對象暴露每一個中間步驟，於是你可以拿着費率表和一張紙復現任何一份保費。**我對三份完整保單正是這麼做的，並把它們作為黃金夾具提交在 `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`；測試斷言引擎與我的手算在**分**的層面上一致，**包括中間值**。」**；**另有三處同一紀律**：**① 同一輸入兩次定價必得同一保費**——**逐字「這聽起來是顯然的，但**它是一條被測過的性質，不是一個假設**」**；**② 三個賠付不變量（賠付不為負、不超過限額、免賠額恰好扣一次）用**兩種方式**驗證**——**手算的邊界矩陣（覆蓋在每一個免賠額、限額與上限的**下方、等於、以及高出一分**三處）＋隨機掃查（**每類結算 10 萬個帶種子的隨機案例、合計 30 萬，零不變量違反**）**；**③ 它有一節專門的**「本模型不做什麼」**，含「費率表是編的、不是任何保險人報備的費率、這裡不為真實保險定價」「真實核保還用駕駛人記錄點數、車輛符號、允許時的信用分、車聯網，且建立在擬合模型上而非五因子鏈」「按比例分攤只是**一種**合理慣例，真實承保人可能順序結算或協商結算」「基準是 Apple 芯片上的單線程純 Python，且結算路徑比定價路徑輕得多，這就是吞吐量差 30 倍的原因」
e.summary_en: A personal auto insurance rating engine, claims settlement calculator and re-rate tool answering what happens to a whole book if one rate factor changes, written from scratch because the author wanted to understand how personal auto pricing and claims payouts work at the arithmetic level; **its most notable feature is a self-imposed arithmetic rule** — verbatim: the rule held to the entire time is that money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only, **with not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand** — ⭐ **so hand-checkability is made a consequence of an arithmetic decision rather than a promise**; **and the hand arithmetic was actually done**: the quote object exposes every intermediate step so a reader can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium, **and that was done for three full policies and committed as golden fixtures, with tests asserting the engine matches the hand arithmetic to the cent including the intermediates**; **three further points follow the same discipline**: rating the same input twice always gives the same premium, which sounds obvious **but is a tested property rather than an assumption**; **three payout invariants — a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once — are verified two ways, by a hand-computed edge matrix covering losses below, at and one cent above every deductible, limit and cap, and by randomised sweeps of 100,000 seeded cases per settlement type, 300,000 in total, with zero invariant violations**; **and it devotes a section to what the model does not do**, stating that the rate tables are invented and are not filed rates from any insurer or regulator, that nothing here prices real insurance, that real rating plans use far more variables such as driving record points, vehicle symbols, credit-based scores where allowed and telematics, built on fitted models rather than a five-factor chain, that the pro rata occurrence rule is one reasonable convention while real carriers may settle sequentially or by negotiation, and that the benchmarks are single-threaded pure Python on Apple silicon with a settlement path much lighter than the rating path, which is why the throughput figures differ by thirty times
e.body:
**policyforge-rating-engine**（仓库 `Mohith26/hartford-pc-rating-claims`，工具名 PolicyForge）**是一份个人车险的费率引擎 ＋ 理赔结算计算器 ＋ 再定价工具**：**三个部分**逐字为 **「a tabular rating engine, a claims settlement calculator, and a small tool that answers "if we change this rate factor, what happens to the whole book?"」**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 23 KB、创建 2026-08-24、最后推送 2026-09-08、topics 为 `actuarial`／`claims`／`deterministic`／`fintech`／`insurance`／`insurtech`／`integer-arithmetic`／`property-testing`／`python`／`rating-engine`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 4,628 字节**；**仓库实测共 27 个条目（23 个文件、4 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「标准答案要放在被检验的系统之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把标准答案**手算出来并提交进仓库**的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一条自设的算术规则，且它把「可手算核对」写成这条规则的后果**——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**逐字为**：**「The rule I held myself to the entire time: **money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only**. **There is not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「金额路径上没有**一个**浮点数」是一个**可被检查的强断言****——**⭐ 即**不是「尽量避免浮点误差」，而是**一个都不许有****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **因与果被写在同一个句子里**：**整数分 ＋ 定点因子 ＋ 只在记录节点四舍五入 → 每一份报价与每一次结算**可以被精确复现并被手算核对****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**「可核对性」被写得最像工程推导的一处**：**先定算术，再得到性质****；**③ **「只在**有记录的**节点上四舍五入」**——**⭐ 即**四舍五入的位置本身是一份**必须被记录在案的清单**（**⭐ 下 ② 中它确实逐处写出了位置**）；**④ **因子被写成**以 1000 为标度的整数****——**⭐ 即**小数也被定点化，而不是只把金额整数化**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它真的手算了，并把结果作为黄金夹具提交**——**逐字为**：**「The `Quote` object **exposes every intermediate step**, so you can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium. **I did exactly that for three full policies and committed them as golden fixtures in `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`; the tests assert the engine matches my hand arithmetic to the cent, including the intermediates.**」**；**并逐字写出计价链与舍入位置**：**「`base -> x territory -> x driver class -> x tier -> x coverage option`」**，**「with a **round half up to the cent after every multiplication, in that exact order**」**；**覆盖类型逐字为** **「bodily injury, property damage, collision, comprehensive, rental」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「我对三份完整保单**正是这么做的**」**——**⭐ 即**标准答案不是程序产生的，**是人拿纸笔算出来的，然后**提交进仓库作为夹具****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「包括中间值」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条最关键的一处**：**多数项目的夹具只固定**最终值**，**而它连**每一步中间量**都要求一致**（**⭐ 即**若中间某一步的舍入位置错了，测试**会在那一步就失败**，而不是等最终值偶然对上**）；**③ **因子链的**顺序**被写明并声明为**精确顺序**（**「in that exact order」**）**——**⭐ 即**乘法可交换但**逐次舍入不可交换**，**故顺序必须固定**；**④ **对象暴露每一步**是这条做法的**接口前提**（**⭐ 即**若中间值不可读出，就不可能被断言**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其实测夹具文件是本会话所见「黄金值」落盘最完整的一次**——**本词条**实测读取** `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`：**其 `comment` 字段逐字为** **「Hand computed golden quotes against the default tables. **Every value was worked out on paper with the documented chain**: base, x territory, x class, x tier, x option, rounding half up to a cent after each multiplication. Amounts are integer cents.」**；**三条夹具各含** `name`、`territory`、`driver_class`、`tier`、`coverages`、**`expected_coverage_cents`**（**逐覆盖类型的分值**）、**`expected_total_cents`**，**以及** **`bi_intermediates`**（**责任险那一条链的五个中间值**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **注释里逐字写了「每一个值都是用纸笔按成文的链算出来的」**——**⭐ 即**该文件**自带其产生方式的说明**，**不需要另读文档才知道这些数从哪来****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**中间值也存进了夹具**（**`bi_intermediates` 含五个数**）**——**⭐ 即**上 ② 中「包括中间值」这句话**在文件层面被证实**；**③ ⭐⭐ **每一个覆盖类型**分开给分值**，**再给合计**（**⭐ 即**部分与总和都被固定，**故**合计错了但分项对、或反之，都能被发现**）；**④ **每条夹具都有**业务语义名字**（**例：`T2 youth standard, full coverage`／`T1 adult preferred, liability plus collision`／`T3 senior nonstandard, max options`**）**——**⭐ 即**夹具覆盖了三类互不相同的风险与保障组合**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「确定性」写成一条被测过的性质，而不是一个假设**——**逐字为**：**「Rating the same input twice always gives the same premium. **That sounds obvious, but it is a tested property, not an assumption.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「这听起来是显然的，但它是一条**被测过的**性质」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「显然的事也要测」说得最直接的一句****（**⭐ 其 topics 里也确实有 `deterministic`**）；**② **⭐ 它与上 ① 的整数算术规则互为因果**：**正因为金额路径无浮点，确定性才是可保证的**——**而它仍然去测**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **三个赔付不变量用两种方式验证，且第二种的规模与方法都被写明**——**逐字为**：**「Three invariants hold everywhere: **a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once**. I verify this **two ways**. First, **a hand computed edge matrix** in `tests/test_claims_edge_matrix.py` covering **losses below, at, and one cent above every deductible, limit, and cap**. Second, **randomized sweeps: 100,000 seeded random cases per settlement type (300,000 total) with zero invariant violations**. The sweep numbers in `results/property_checks.json` **come from the same code the tests run**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两种方式互为补充且各有分工**：**手算边界矩阵**负责**边界**（**下方／等于／高出一分**三处）**，**随机扫查**负责**广度**（**30 万案例**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「测了很多」，而是**边界与广度分开覆盖****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **边界矩阵是**手算的****（**⭐ 即**第二处「标准答案来自纸笔」**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **「零不变量违反」是一个**零指标****（**⭐ 与上一轮 [[medical-opinion-extractor]] 的「样版判别失败 0 件」同族**）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「扫查的数字来自测试所运行的同一份代码」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这一句很重要：**它排除了「提交的结果文件与测试跑的不是同一实现」这种情况****（**⭐ 即**公开的数字**与**被验证的行为**被绑在同一实现上**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **三个不变量的措辞本身很精确**——**逐字为「赔付不为负」「不超过其限额」「免赔额恰好扣一次」**⭐⭐ **即**第三条是**「恰好一次」而不是「至少一次」**——**⭐ 即**它同时封住了**重复扣除**与**漏扣**两个方向**（**⭐ 本词条认为这与本会话此前记过的「两个方向都查」属同一纪律的又一次出现**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **理赔结算的每一类规则都被逐条写出，且**最后一条把顺序钉住****——**逐字为**：**「**Bodily injury** applies the per person cap to each claimant, and if the capped total still exceeds the per occurrence limit **it scales everyone down pro rata using the largest remainder method in integer cents, so the payments sum to exactly the occurrence limit with no lost or invented cents**.」**；**「**Collision** caps the loss at the vehicle’s actual cash value, then subtracts the deductible **once**, floored at zero.」**；**「**Property damage** is a plain min(loss, limit).」**；**「**Rental** caps the daily rate, then caps the aggregate.」**；**「**A property style coverage** applies a coinsurance penalty (scale the loss by carried over required), then the deductible, then the limit cap, **in that fixed order**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **按比例分摊用**最大余数法**且**在整数分内**完成**，**目标是「赔付合计恰好等于每次事故限额，**没有丢失或凭空多出的分」**——**⭐ 即**它不允许分摊产生一分钱的缺口或多余**（**⭐ 这与上 ① 的整数算术是同一条规则在分摊上的应用**）；**② ⭐⭐ **碰撞险「免赔额只扣**一次**，下限为零」**——**与不变量逐字对应**；**③ ⭐⭐ **财产类保障的**三个步骤顺序被钉住**（**共保惩罚 → 免赔额 → 限额上限**）**——**⭐ 即**又一次说明顺序不可交换**；**④ **每一类的处理写成一句可核对的规则**。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「本模型不做什么」一节写得非常具体，且其中一条解释了**为什么吞吐量数字长那个样子****——**逐字为**：**「## What this does not model** The rate tables are invented. I picked numbers that look plausible for a six month personal auto term, but **they are not filed rates from any insurer or regulator, and nothing here prices real insurance**. Real rating plans also use far more variables (**driving record points, vehicle symbols, credit based scores where allowed, telematics**) and are **built on fitted models, not a five factor chain**. **The claims side handles the arithmetic of limits, deductibles, and coinsurance, not the adjusting judgment that produces the loss number in the first place.** **The pro rata occurrence rule is one reasonable convention; real carriers may settle sequentially or by negotiation.** The synthetic book is uniform-ish random, so **the re-rate distribution describes my generated book, not any real portfolio**. **Benchmarks are single threaded pure Python on Apple silicon and the settlement path is much lighter than the rating path, which is why the throughput numbers differ by 30x.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「费率表是编的。我挑了一些对半年期个人车险看起来合理的数字，**但它们不是任何保险人或监管机构报备的费率，这里不为真实保险定价**」**——**⭐ 即**对自己的数字的**权威性**给出了明确否定**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「理赔一侧处理的是限额、免赔额与共保的算术，**而不是产生那个损失数字的理算判断**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题里一个很重要的**边界层**：**它算的是拿到损失数字**之后**的事，而**损失数字本身的来源**被明确划到模型之外****；**③ ⭐⭐ **「按比例分摊只是**一种**合理惯例，真实承保人可能顺序结算或协商结算」**——**⭐ 即**它指出自己的做法是**一种选择而非唯一正确做法****（**⭐ 这一点对做实务的同学尤其值得记**）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **吞吐量差异**被解释**（**单线程纯 Python、Apple 芯片、且结算路径比定价路径轻得多**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「基准数字的范围」解释得最完整的一处之一****（**⭐ 与上一轮 [[insurance-portfolio-performance]] 的「不要把好看的数从它所属的口径栏里拎出来」同源**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **再定价工具的参数与结果都被逐字写出，且它声明可重复**——**逐字为**：**「builds a seeded 10,000 policy synthetic book, rates it under the current tables and under a revised set（**the default scenario bumps territory T3 from 1.275 to 1.350 and the nonstandard tier from 1.450 to 1.550**），and reports the premium change distribution in basis points. **policyforge-rating-engine**（倉庫 `Mohith26/hartford-pc-rating-claims`，工具名 PolicyForge）**是一份個人車險的費率引擎 ＋ 理賠結算計算器 ＋ 再定價工具**：**三個部分**逐字為 **「a tabular rating engine, a claims settlement calculator, and a small tool that answers "if we change this rate factor, what happens to the whole book?"」**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NONE**（**實測該倉庫無任何許可文件**）、主語言 Python、體量 23 KB、創建 2026-08-24、最後推送 2026-09-08、topics 為 `actuarial`／`claims`／`deterministic`／`fintech`／`insurance`／`insurtech`／`integer-arithmetic`／`property-testing`／`python`／`rating-engine`**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 4,628 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 27 個條目（23 個文件、4 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標準答案要放在被檢驗的系統之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把標準答案**手算出來並提交進倉庫**的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 一條自設的算術規則，且它把「可手算核對」寫成這條規則的後果**：**「The rule I held myself to the entire time: **money is integer cents, factors are integers scaled by 1000, and rounding is half up at documented points only**. **There is not a single float anywhere in the money path, which is what makes every quote and every settlement exactly reproducible and checkable by hand.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「金額路徑上沒有**一個**浮點數」是一個**可被檢查的強斷言****（不是「儘量避免浮點誤差」，而是一個都不許有）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 因與果被寫在同一個句子裡**（整數分 ＋ 定點因子 ＋ 只在記錄節點四捨五入 → 每一份報價與每一次結算可以被精確復現並被手算核對）——**⭐ 這是本輪四條裡**「可核對性」被寫得最像工程推導的一處**：先定算術，再得到性質****；**③「只在**有記錄的**節點上四捨五入」**——**⭐ 即**四捨五入的位置本身是一份必須被記錄在案的名單****；**④ 因子被寫成**以 1000 為標度的整數****（小數也被定點化）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它真的手算了，並把結果作為黃金夾具提交**：**「The `Quote` object **exposes every intermediate step**, so you can sit down with the rate tables and a piece of paper and reproduce any premium. **I did exactly that for three full policies and committed them as golden fixtures in `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`; the tests assert the engine matches my hand arithmetic to the cent, including the intermediates.**」**；**並逐字寫出**計價鏈 **「`base -> x territory -> x driver class -> x tier -> x coverage option`」** 與 **「a **round half up to the cent after every multiplication, in that exact order**」**（覆蓋類型逐字為 bodily injury, property damage, collision, comprehensive, rental）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「我對三份完整保單**正是這麼做的**」**——**⭐ 即**標準答案不是程序產生的，是人拿紙筆算出來的，然後提交進倉庫作為夾具****；**② ⭐⭐⭐「包括中間值」**——**⭐ 這是本條最關鍵的一處**：多數項目的夾具只固定**最終值**，而它連**每一步中間量**都要求一致（若中間某一步的捨入位置錯了，測試**會在那一步就失敗**）；**③ 因子鏈的**順序**被寫明並聲明為**精確順序****（乘法可交換但**逐次捨入不可交換**，故順序必須固定）；**④ 對象暴露每一步是這條做法的**接口前提****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其實測夾具文件是本會話所見「黃金值」落盤最完整的一次**——**本詞條**實測讀取** `fixtures/golden_quotes.json`：**其 `comment` 字段逐字為** **「Hand computed golden quotes against the default tables. **Every value was worked out on paper with the documented chain**: base, x territory, x class, x tier, x option, rounding half up to a cent after each multiplication. Amounts are integer cents.」**；**三條夾具各含** `name`／`territory`／`driver_class`／`tier`／`coverages`／**`expected_coverage_cents`**／**`expected_total_cents`**／**`bi_intermediates`**（責任險那條鏈的五個中間值）**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 註釋裡逐字寫了「每一個值都是用紙筆按成文的鏈算出來的」**——**⭐ 即**該文件**自帶其產生方式的說明****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**中間值也存進了夾具**（`bi_intermediates` 含五個數）**——**⭐ 即**「包括中間值」這句話**在文件層面被證實****；**③ ⭐⭐ 每一個覆蓋類型**分開給分值**再給合計**（部分與總和都被固定）；**④ 每條夾具都有**業務語義名字**（T2 youth standard, full coverage／T1 adult preferred, liability plus collision／T3 senior nonstandard, max options）——**⭐ 即**夾具覆蓋三類互不相同的風險與保障組合**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把「確定性」寫成一條被測過的性質**：**「Rating the same input twice always gives the same premium. **That sounds obvious, but it is a tested property, not an assumption.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「這聽起來是顯然的，但它是一條**被測過的**性質」**——**⭐ 這是本站所收條目裡**對「顯然的事也要測」說得最直接的一句****（其 topics 裡也確實有 `deterministic`）；**② 它與 ① 的整數算術規則互為因果**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **三個賠付不變量用兩種方式驗證，且第二種的規模與方法都被寫明**：**「Three invariants hold everywhere: **a payment is never negative, never exceeds its limit, and a deductible is applied exactly once**.
